decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1.	The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times:
11:00 to 15:00 and 17:00 to 23:00hrs Monday to Friday; and 11:00 to 23:00hrs on Saturdays and Sundays.

Condition : 2 - 2.	No amplified music shall be played in the premises outside the following times:
11:00 to 15:00 and 17:00 to 23:00hrs Monday to Friday; and 11:00 to 23:00hrs on Saturdays and Sundays.

Condition : 3 - 3.	Unless otherwise authorised in writing by the local planning authority, all doors, windows and other openings in the external structure of the building, other than those in the elevation facing Chiswick High Road, shall be kept closed at all times except when they are being used as an escape route during an emergency.
description: Variation to condition 1 (opening hours) of planning application 00248/460/P5 granted on appeal APP/F5540/02/1095981 dated 20/09/2006 to allow a change to the opening hours of 11am - 3pm and 5pm - 11pm Monday to Friday and open all day from 11am - 11pm Saturday to Sunday
